title: The return to Fukushima: Radiation and risk statistics
content:
Abstract
Across the globe, many of the most difficult public policy decisions involve risks that are hard to see, hard to explain, and easy to misunderstand. Sameh ElBadry and David Schley describe how, a decade after the Fukushima nuclear power plant disaster, villagers returning to farm their land face the challenge of overcoming fear and uncertainty about their crops
